text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it seems the competition's heated back
up. 
With only two events left,
I suppose that means we're 
approaching the climax.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, are you ready for the 2000 meter race,
Digital-kun? 
Or should I say——

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready to answer Tap-kun's burning
passion?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aha. Hahaha. Ha… To be perfectly honest, 
I'm honored she feels that way.
TOO honored. 
I feel like a dam about to burst.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You know, I was,
well… I was too obsessed to see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I mean… I mean, come on!! 
I love every Uma to death!
I love love love love LOVE them!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I love them on turf! I love them on dirt!
In the regionals, the nationals,
and all over the world!!
I can't choose between them, 
and I don't WANT to choose between them!
I love them all!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That love pushed me forward,
and let me run!! 
No matter where I was,
or what I was doing… 
You were all so awe-inspiring——

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My infinite love for you all gave me
strength. 
It carried me to where I am now. 
…So now I realize——

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's something I have to do today. 
…Something only I can do.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So, anyway! Sorry, but I must go now,
Tachyon-san! 
Your humble servant Digitan is off to the
2000 meter race!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ……Yes, you enjoy yourself, now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
——The workings of your mind and speech are
cryptic as ever. 
But that's exactly what makes you so
unexpectedly entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Honestly.
You are nothing if not my roommate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (——Let's write a story.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Instead of a pen,
we'll write it with our legs, our bodies,
and 
our hearts. I'll look you right in the eyes,
and flash you a brave smile——)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ……Hey now, there's a new look on your face. Haha. Finally ready to take me seriously, Digital?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ……Heh heh. Yes I am.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do you want a taste of the weight of the
autumn shield? 
Or would you like to try the strength that
took on the world 
for size?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whichever you want to see,
your wish is my command. 
After all——
I'm the invincible all-rounder.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, let's write a story! 
The perfect story of your dreams,
written just for you!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Tap-san… You were willing to set your gaze
on me, of 
all people… So I'll answer your gaze as much
as I can!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Allow me to play the role… 
Of Final Boss Digitan!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Come at me with everything you've got. 
You think you can claim me as your
treasure? 
Then go ahead and try!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ha… Hahaha, HAHAHAHAHAH! Hell yeah, Digital… Now we're gettin' somewhere! ——You're on!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now, c'mon, let's go!! 
HAAAAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And they're off for the 2000 meter race!
Tap Dance City's 
opening things with a powerful early lead!
She accelerates in a flash!
S-She's showing no signs of slowing down!

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What… What an audacious runawayyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(What,
you think I'm reckless? Just going crazy?
Nah!! 
I'm serious!! DEAD serious!! Right here,
right now——)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna knock you down,
Agnes Digital…!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I hear you, Tap-san—— I can feel it! 
I can feel how desperately you're trying to
beat me!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to answer that passion!
Even if it kills me——!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(There's a simple reason why!! 
If my oshi tells me she wants to hear my
voice… 
If she tells me she wants me to give my
all!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I'm out of breath!!
Even if I'm dead on the ground!! 
I'll shout and shout,
'till my lungs burst!! AND ANSWER HER!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (THIS… IS AN OTAKU'S PRIIIIIIIIIIDEEE!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
——The race isn't over yet, Tap-san!! 
On my pride as an otaku,
I'm catching up to you, 
no matter what…!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huff…! Heh…! 
Oh no you don't!
I wanna keep seein' you burning hot!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
'Till the very last second—— 
I'm gonna make you chase me down!!

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
——That's the raaaaaaaaaaace!! 
The winner of this fierce 2000 meter race
is——

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
For the white team, Agnes Digital!! 
Tap Dance City's massive runaway couldn't
escape her 
incredible skills!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huff… Huff… Hahhhh… 
——Aw, shit!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Bwargh!? A-A-A-A-A-A-Are you all right,
Tap-shan!? 
L-Let me see your hand… Wait, no, look,
don't touch… 
No, no, now's not the time to be——!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hey, where'd the cool Digital go, huh? Not that it matters, really.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
——This ain't the last you'll see of me!! 
You got that, Digital?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh…? Erm,
d-do you mean… you want to race again…?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Of course! Next time… Yeah, I really wanna race you at a G1. Actually, while I'm at it—— I wanna have a big ol' bash at a Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what I gotta win to make it
into that race. 
I'm runnin' my way up there,
no matter what. 
So you better be there, too, you got that,
Digital?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's you and me have another showdown
sometime. 
…Promise?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ～～～!! (GOOD GRAVY, SHE'S H-A-W-T!!!!!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
P- PROMISE!! 
Next time, hmm, maybe I'll, er,
play a royal character or 
something!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Man, who said anything about playing a character? I want you! Ahahahaha!!
